overrides.real_en: ...Wait. Come to think of it, what's happened to Zenon...?

Fotona, there are a few settings we need to go
through for the new body.
Fotona...I kept my promise to you...
...At least I'm glad Zenon departed looking so content.
Zenon spent thousands of years with this ship as its captain, too.
Even if there was no other way... Zenon, that was terribly reckless.
If the owner of this heart is the one you speak of, Fotona, then it's worth sacrificing everything.
What?! But then, Zenon, your life...!
You mustn't, Zenon! I'll take over. Please get some rest.
Troy! What brings you here?!
This is Troy. She is also from Joka, and holds a position second only to Zenon.
Troy, this is hard for me to say, but... Zenon has already passed away back there...
Troy... Surely you didn't need to go that far?

It's good to see you again, Fotona. That's another
one I owe you.
N-not yet... I can't show such a disgraceful side of myself before Iliana...

Indigo hair, eyes like emeralds... You're Quijermo's
daughter.

Then one day, Cara told me you were still alive,
and the color came flooding back...
Hey, pretty boy! You'll regret picking a fight with the great Majide!
There's nothing the great Majide hates more than guys like you!
N-no way... the great Majide... defeated...?
I'll show you what happens when you pick a fight with Daitou!

But this is...a problem for me. Claire himself made
me promise to never reveal my face.
Ooooh! Raksha, I'm truly honored!

He'll make quite a face when he realizes what's
going on. I can't wait to see! Can you, Otto?

What'd you say? The great Majide will win
the Great Gladiatorial Festival and rule this city!

...How unusual, Sister,
for you to take an interest in a human man.

...My older sister's Kiss of the Underworld.
That man can never escape her now.

Another magnificent battle. You think so too...don't
you, Otto?
Understood, Sorell.
Enough! I'd rather go with Leda than stay with you, Mom!
So, what do you think, Theodora? He's a really good-looking man, isn't he?
Don't misunderstand me. I'm not against love. Unlike my older sister Eishet.

Especially you, Sister. The Diadem of Ignorance
resides in you, after all.
Yes, Leda. I'll always keep those words close to my heart.
And once again, Anna from the organizing committee has come to give you an official announcement!
Heehee. Talimun, you really do love money, don't you?
Sorell... That is, perhaps, indiscreet...

If someone is going to break him, it can only be me.
Don't you agree, Otto?
Iliana... I'm so sorry you've had to go to such lengths for someone like me.
Oh... Oh, Iliana...! How fortunate I am...!
I agree with my older sister Eishet. Our trump card doesn't work against that man.

When that happens, Otto, we'll have to say
goodbye. That'll be sad.

Ah... And doesn't it have a wonderful timbre?
Don't you think so too, Otto?
Thanks! I got it, Buccaneer!
Leda, Theodora... why do you both have to go this far?!
This is nothing! Theodora, you'd better make sure you don't mess up either!
We're fine over here! Theodora, you and the others be careful too!
Fabio, you use some strange magic. I've never seen anything quite like it.
Even with Centurio and the others here, we're in danger if this keeps up.
Yeah. I know, Centurio!
Leda, stop! That power is far too dangerous!

What a mess! Have you lost your mind, Buccaneer?
I'm sorry, but I won't go along with this.

I want only to save you from that. And if I fail, then
I'll have failed to keep my promise to Quijermo.
That was my promise to Quijermo... and it's my one and only wish!
Then if that's your reason, Leda, you should step aside!
Bertrand is a good guy too! Why won't you even try talking things out?!
I know Leda understands that too, deep down! I know she does!
That's why Buccaneer wants to stop you!
Of course I want to save my dad. That's part of why I want to stop Leda, but...
And I don't want Bertrand to die either, but...!
Buccaneer... I don't know what to do.
Yeah... I won, Leda.
You're Zenzele, aren't you?! Give Ultand back!
Ultand had a family she'd been forced to live apart from...
The painting is crumbling! Kai, we must get out!
And everything the people of Saramis wish for is for Yu Phas...!

All right, Bro! And you too, Kai!
Let's flatten these guys!

He will, won't he? Castor and I are very proud of
our Kai.
Sorry, Bertrand... This is as far as I go. My son's strong...
I know, Bertrand. I'm going to throw everything I've got at you!
Could it be some kind of messenger of the gods? Fotona's altar is nearby...
Haven't I always told you to treat this statue as Aurora herself?! Oh, forgive me, Aurora!

Why do we have a statue of Aurora anyway?
Fotona's temple's closer to the village.
You fool! It's not about how close the temple is. Aurora is beautiful!
...You've actually seen Aurora before?
<ACA>Beautiful? You mean as beautiful as you think Aurora is, Pop?
And stop treating Aurora's statue like that! Hey, don't throw it! Stop!
Really?! Thank you so much!
Like insects drawn to a flame... Raksha, everything is guided by your will.

This is Sorell's decree. It's beyond someone of
my standing to interfere.
This is Aurora herself, the goddess of stars and seafaring.
W-wait, Aurora?! You mean the goddess whose statue we had at home?!

What? Kai? I hadn't mentally prepared myself for
this. Well, how could I?
It's so nice to meet you! I'm Tiara, a friend of Kai's.

Very nice to meet you both. Thank you for being
such good friends to Kai.
Kai, may I have a better look at you?
...Now it feels a little more real to me. Thank you for coming all this way to see me, Kai.
But one day, he took Aurora out of the temple, and they ran away together.
I serve Aurora. If I had a family, I wouldn't be able to fulfill my duties.
Aurora really was incredible... I've never seen anyone so beautiful.
I've never seen Aurora look as happy as she did then.
I do hope you'll come and see Aurora from time to time.
Castor's...gone... Are you alright, Kai?
This isn't the end! There has to be a way to save your father, Kai!
<ACA>Yeah. Thank you... Centurio.
They say it's a sacred gladiatorial contest held as an offering in hopes of reviving the Great Emperor Dagda.
That's right! If you win, Sorell, the Divine Sovereign, will grant any wish you make!
If I enter the Great Gladiatorial Festival and win, I can ask Sorell to stop Pop's execution!
Huh? Centurio, what are you doing here?
N-no! You mustn't! That's far too dangerous! Just think how worried Aurora would be!
...Centurio, you know these kids?
Whaaat?! Th-this kid is Aurora's child?!

I'm sure he'll be thrilling us with a wonderful match
in no time. Won't he, Otto?

The brave boy comes to visit daddy in jail...
Such a lovely story, isn't it, Otto?

I'm Kai of Ribeira village. Thanks again for helping
me, Iliana.
So that's all the great 'Windstorm Castor' has taught his son?
By the way, do you know someone called the White-Haired Demon?
Um, White-Haired Demon... My name is Kai. I saw your special match.
Then I heard you were here too, White-Haired Demon, so I wanted to talk to you.
Um, White-Haired Demon, why are you in a place like this—
Um... Bertrand, I have a favor to ask you!
Yes! Thank you so much, Bertrand!
Hehe, good day, Theodora. Yes, we're taking part too.
People in Saramis worship Yu Phas, which is unusual in the lands of Dagda.
Thank you, Sister!
And you, Kai? May I see your left hand, please?
Kai, where did you get this jewel?
Kai, is your mother perhaps connected to the temple?

You know, you kind of remind me of my
mom, Orhel.
I was just thinking... could this jewel of mine and Theodora's arm somehow be...?
Well, I'd better get going too. See you later, Theodora, everyone!
Sorell, do you think me...
Um, so, Anna, did you need something from us?
Thank you so much, Anna!
Bertrand! Can you train me again today?
Besides, Brother, you're really good at teaching. It's interesting how different your training is from Pop's.
Ah... Thanks, Bertrand. Do you think I've gotten a little stronger now?
Yeah! Thanks, Bertrand!
Would you mind keeping your distance from this child, Anacharsis of Agartha?
U-um, Dietrich, thank you... very much for earlier.
Dietrich, that sword isn't an ordinary sword, is it?
A-Anatolia! You were amazing earlier!
Hey, did something happen between you and Anatolia's group?
Hey, did something happen between you and Anatolia's group?
Attention! An official announcement from Anna, organizer of the Dagsion Great Gladiatorial Festival!
Anna, thank you so much!
Mm-hmm! Anna will be cheering you on in the next match too, so everyone, do your best!
I never thought I'd end up fighting alongside Theodora and the others, though.
You know, Fabio... do you have a lot of troubles to deal with?
Even so, Fabio, you seem surprisingly good at looking after people, don't you?

I'm Kai from Ribeira village. Is there something I
can help you with, Aswan?

Since you're involved with the games, it's fortuitous
that I met you, Kai from Ribeira village.
I'd like to beg a favor of you, Kai.
H-how does Aswan know that?!
Oh, man... Aswan, are you actually someone extraordinary?
Aswan, we're here.
We'll keep this secret from our sisters, right, Otto?
I guess Aswan is the reason you have to go back, Brother.
Aurora, I've brought the Divine Child.

Kai! Your left hand, is it alright? Has anything else
out of the ordinary happened?
Actually, Kai, I have a favor to ask of you.

Your red jewel may well be one of these
treasures, Kai.

Kai, since you're now strong enough to earn victory
in the games, I feel I can entrust this task to you.
This might be something very important to both of us.

Kai, I want you to go there and see it with your
own eyes.
Aurora, isn't that entire area off-limits after the incident at Damascar?
Really?! If Ultand is coming with us too, that'll be fun!

Thank you, Ultand. Yes, I'll entrust Kai and his
friends to you as well.
Huh... Ultand, are you maybe a little nervous?
Could it be some kind of mistake? Or is Centurio actually lying to us?
These are direct orders from Aurora herself. You there, clear the way at once!
Centurio! Please forgive us! And thank you for your service!
Well, Centurio, I thought you were just a really inflexible guy.
It's an island dedicated to the demon god Balor, the father of Yu Phas.
Centurio, are you sure we'll be all right? Isn't it far too dangerous...?
But this Divine Child carries the blood of Yu Phas, whom you worship.
Kai, your eyes changed color! What's happened?!

But as you saw, Kai, the tomb is empty now.
That can only mean one thing.

I wonder if the jewel in Kai's hand is what's left of
one of my grandfather's eyes.

Kai, what you saw with your own eyes might have
been the underworld, Balor's domain.
Oh? What's wrong, Sister?
Be quiet. Our older sister is listening to Father's voice right now.
The Kingdom of Damascar had a temple to Yu Phas, who was Aurora's mother...
Apparently, all its people were devout believers in Yu Phas.
C-Centurio! What's that?!
C-C-Centurio! Wh-what was that just now?!
That was what took Yu Phas's life. I imagine the Divine Sovereign never wanted to see it again.

Excuse me, Sister, but Kai isn't interested
in that kind of thing!
Thanks! But you were amazing too, Leda.
Leda really is wonderful. And so cool! I might even start looking up to her!
By the way, Leda, what wish do you want granted by taking part in this tournament?
...Leda was a little scary, wasn't she?

But things are changing. At the moment, I'd like it if
you, Sorell, would speak with my mother.
Um... This may be rude, but could I ask about your family?

Sorell... Your daughter, Aurora, is locked up in
the temple. I heard you won't meet with her...
...But what if the winner of the tournament asked you to meet with Aurora and speak to her—
Hello again! Another official announcement from Anna, organizer of the Dagsion Great Gladiatorial Festival!
Yes! I'm Ultand Serowain. And thank you for all your hard work, Anna.
Ah, right, right! That reminds me—Anna's main reason for coming today!
Thanks! We'll be fine, Anna.
Yeah! Bertrand was every bit as amazing as I'd expected!

Storm of Roses is Leda's group. We recently teamed
up with them.
...But Leda's spellsongs might be the greatest threat after all.
Bertrand was impressive, but the people backing him up are no ordinary fighters either.
But Leda's spellsongs are a little different... They seem stronger than ordinary ones.
Right. Leda and her team must have made it this far through skill, not luck.
I want Aurora to be happy too, so I'll give it my all!
Hey... Ultand, it hadn't really sunk in until now.
Leda wants to kill Bertrand to avenge her father.
If she can't do that, Leda will stay trapped in the past, unable to move forward.
No matter how sad Leda is over her father's murder, I just can't bring myself to sympathize with her.
Leda's wish is to kill someone to settle her grudge.
If Castor is saved, lots of people will be happy. You and Aurora... and of course me, too.
Come to think of it, Cara once said something like this...
But Leda, there are people who love you and worry about you.

I think Buccaneer was really worried when he saw what
you'd become.
Huh? Aren't you with Leda?
About that... Leda informed me that she'd dismissed me as her attendant.
I see... But Buccaneer, no one cared about Leda more than you did...
I think Leda still needs you, Buccaneer.
Even if Leda fired you, she's not exactly the type to say how she really feels—
Maybe she's actually waiting for you to come after her. I don't know.
Gabriel, what's wrong? You seem pretty serious.
Did you already know about it, Ultand?
Anna, who's going to fill this empty spot on the bracket?
I understand how you feel, Leda. You have a wish you can't give up on.
I've accepted it, even if it means crushing your wish, Leda.
Hehe... Forgive me. I'm going to be a little cruel today.
Uh... You're Buccaneer, right? You were with Leda.
I want you to defeat the princess... Leda. I want you to stop her.
Huh...? But aren't you on Leda's side?
I can't believe Bertrand was the one who killed Leda's father...
So Leda's been waiting for a chance to take revenge ever since.
Then... does she really have to kill Bertrand?
Even my lord, Quijermo, seemed to acknowledge General Bertrand in his own way.
Buccaneer... I can't make any promises.
I have my own reasons why I absolutely can't lose, even if I'm up against Leda.
But I'm glad that's what you wanted to ask me, Buccaneer.
Yes. He told me when we were alone on the day you and your friends came to visit, Kai.
In the time he had left, he'd managed to raise you into a fine young man and bring you to meet me.
And he made me promise I wouldn't tell you or your friends.
He's terribly stubborn. He didn't want you to have anything more to worry about.

And you, Kai, since you're half my blood, will live
for five hundred years, at least.
But... even after your life comes to an end, I'll go on living for much longer.
I knew what I was taking on when I married Castor and gave birth to you.
Aurora, pardon the interruption. An emergency has arisen.
Some unscrupulous people have even been spreading rumors that Aurora is behind it.
We've been doing everything we can to investigate, if only to defend Aurora's honor, but...

Hmm... Kai, perhaps you could help Centurio search
the temple.
Your eyes might catch traces no one else can see.
Now that you mention it, this woman does look a little like Ultand...
Then... does that mean Ultand was abducted and trapped inside the painting...?

Don't be deceived, Aurora. Not by the falsehoods of
a man like Miwai!

I think it is as Kai says. Indeed, there's something
very strange about this painting.

Standing here, it gives me the same feeling as Kai's
eye. It's as if Balor's power is seeping out of it.
Kai, can you please bear with me awhile?
Kai, everyone, thank you for coming today.
Did Sorell give you any clues?
Yes. I've learned quite a few new things, and I want Kai and the others to hear them too.
So what should I do? I want to save Ultand as soon as I can.

Thank you, Kai. But first let me entrust you
with this.
Aurora?! Are you serious? There are strict rules about handling the Supreme Arcs...
Kai will be fine with it. After all, he's my son.
This time, I'm coming too. I can't keep leaving you and the others to face danger without me.

Kai! Aurora! I'm so happy you've returned, safe
and sound.
It's all right now. You can go home, Sister.
You're important to me, Sister. I want you to be happy, no matter what.
That's why I'm so glad we got you back from him, Sister.

What's this? Zenzele's brush? It has the same energy
as Kai's jewel.
It is I, Raksha. You summoned me, Sorell.

Kai, use the power of your eye to find the seal on
this painting.

We'll no doubt face many dangers. Kai, are you
certain you're comfortable with this?
<ACA>Of course. I have to save Ultand, no matter what.
The spear ought to open it. Try it, Kai.

Kai, I'm going to cast a spell on you. It's a charm my
mother taught me, once upon a time.

I understand. Thank you, Kai.
I'll be cheering you on, so do your best!
Even if we manage to beat Theodora and her clan in this match...
It's Bertrand's clan and Dietrich's clan that are still in the running.

What you just said makes me think of Miwai's
face the other day.
I think that's how he put it... Miwai.
I'll pray to Yu Phas that your wish comes true.
Sorry, Sister, but I'm not going to let you win this time.

He is quite the mysterious child, sporting the right
eye too. You think so as well, don't you Otto?
Sister, what are you planning to do?!
Sister, you must be tired. We're here.

Oh, hello. I've never seen this girl before. Is she your
wife, Kai?
Really? I thought talk of that sort might start coming up at Kai's age.
Kai has told me a great deal about you.
And this is my mother—the Aurora you wanted to meet, Sister.

It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Aurora,
Kai's mother. Greetings, Your Majesty.
Aurora, the only daughter of the goddess Yu Phas, to whom we owe so much.
Sister, that's great! You should be all right for a while now.
And I rather like you when you act all high and mighty, Sister.
Aurora, I have urgent business to attend to, so I must take my leave.

Oh, hello. I've never seen this girl before. Is she your
wife, Kai?
Really? I thought talk of that sort might start coming up at Kai's age.
Kai has told me a great deal about you.

Kai. I must ask, what will you do with yourself after
the games are finished?

Kai, do you think you can take me with you
sometime...outside?

Seeing you bring a girl here reminded me
of old times, Kai.
Gabriel, is it all right if I visit Dad again today?
I know! Thank you, Gabriel!
Hello, Iliana. Are you here to see Bertrand again?
Kai, do you know that woman?
Is this why you're doing that? You don't want Kai to see your clothes stained with the blood you coughed up?

Kai brought me along. Looks like you've lost even
more weight.
Kai?! Is that true?
Brother, let me help too!
Dad, Brother, this isn't the time for idle chatter!
Verafi, the bandits have already been defeated.

Castor, please just hold on a little longer. Kai and I
will do everything we can to save you.
Kai, thank you. I'm so glad we got to go out today.
I've come here time and again! Why won't you grant me an audience with Aurora?!
Aurora isn't seeing anyone.
You say she isn't seeing anyone. Is that truly Aurora's own wish?!
Eek! Look how furious she is! Theodora is really angry.
Bonaparte, what's Sister making such a fuss about?
Before we leave, Her Majesty insists on meeting Aurora, the daughter of Yu Phas, to whom we owe so much.
Um... Sister, could you come over here for a moment?
Sister, you just want to see Aurora, right?
Of course. I must tell Aurora how the people of Saramis feel.
Eek! Look how furious she is! Theodora is really angry.
What do you mean, Sister?
Aurora seems a little down. I was hoping you could hear her out.
Kai, may I talk to you for a moment? There's something I've been worrying about for a long time.
And here you are, Kai, fighting so hard for Castor.
Mom, but he... Miwai was different.
Thank you, Kai.
Nothing stays the same. Kai, who was once so little, has grown into such a fine young man.
Kai, I'm going to speak with Father.
It's okay, Mom. I'll win, I promise. Then I'll bring you before Sorell.
Yes... Thank you, Kai...
It's your final fight, Kai.
Mom, Centurio, you both came!
May Kai return safely... and may everything work out.
I only made it this far thanks to all of you. Tiara, Peter, Sis—
Bertrand is a formidable opponent. I honestly don't know if we can beat him.

I'm so pleased that you are blessed with such good
friends, Kai.
Centurio, what's gotten into you? It's not like you to be so deep in thought.
Brother...
Goliath... Sorry, but Bertrand...
Kai worked so hard, so why would you do something so foolish?!
As I listened to Bertrand's story, I came to admire him. And I thought—
But... even if Bertrand were saved, you'd be executed, Pop!
Um... Still, I feel like Mother and Sorell are a little alike.

But I want to live life to the fullest, making memories
with them. Kai and his friends taught me that.
Kai! It's all very well for you to say that, but what am I supposed to do?!
Oh, honestly! Kai is always teaching me things. I'm such a hopeless mother...
Ultand and Centurio live nearby, so they often come by to check on us, but—
Oh? Sorell, you seem rather happy. Did something good happen?
Brother, I've finally made it this far.
So the person you mentioned before, Goliath, was Bertrand!

What is the meaning of this, Centurio?! Why is
Castor fighting Kai?

I concur with Buccaneer. We'd be well advised to
retreat, Miss Leda.

What a mess! Have you lost your mind, Buccaneer?
I'm sorry, but I won't go along with this.

I want only to save you from that. And if I fail, then
I'll have failed to keep my promise to Quijermo.
That was my promise to Quijermo... and my one and only wish!
Buccaneer... I don't know what to do.
I really hope Buccaneer's OK.
Open your eyes, Quijermo! Please.
Cara, whom I serve, also wishes for you to achieve your goal.
Quijermo's daughter.

While alive, Quijermo spoke of you often as
the great general of Arago.

We lay low and save our strength now, then avenge
Quijermo's death when the time is right.

We'll go to Mardle. He's charged with
protecting the shrine in Ortill county.
Quijermo trusted him very much.

But first we've got to get out of this city. Then we'll
find Mardle.
Quijermo showed it to me once.
Hey, Sirocco. What's Kassite like?

For example, the way Buccaneer carries himself tells me
he's a soldier, through and through.

But what of you, Miss Leda? Buccaneer serves you like
a retainer, does he not?

And that Bjor fellow seemed to know exactly who
Buccaneer was. Or did you think I hadn't noticed?
Um, Sirocco... what exactly is orichalcum?

I admit that thunderous voice of yours did come in
handy, Buccaneer. It helped guide many to safety.

But here you are. Cara would be overjoyed to hear
this news.

Mardle took us in and protected us. He was
in charge of one of the Dagda temple shrines there.

If memory serves, Mardle was a high priest
in Dagda's temple.

Then one day I snuck into Grand Aragon, the capital
of Arago. I didn't tell Mardle.

That's when Mardle began hinting that
Cydonia had been swept up into larger conspiracies.
Mardle...what is this?
Mardle, I...I don't understand...
A-ah... Mardle...what are you...
Mardle, what do you mean?!
Mardle!

Mardle had left me his list. So, I set out to
take my revenge on those he had named.

they would have found a way to carry out their plan,
with or without Mardle's testimony.

I can't forgive Mardle for everything he's
done, but I am grateful to him.
It's true that Cara was deeply concerned about you.
So I can say that my actions from here on are in accordance with Cara's wishes.
I think you should meet Cara. I'm sure she'll lend you her aid.
I've come with a report on a certain matter... and people I'd like to introduce to Cara in connection with it.

It's been too long, Cara. I'm so glad to see that
you're well.
Forgive me. I took refuge with Mardle and remained in hiding.

Lady Leda came to Cara's temple to train in the arts
when she was just 10 years old.

It is. The title is given only to those who earn special
recognition from the goddess Cara herself.

Thereupon, my dear goddess Cara bestowed upon
Brachi Dia a new family name—Cohendia.

I appreciate you worrying over my well-being, Cara.
It's more than I deserve.
Huh? Olympia is playing as hard as she can, but no sound is coming out...?
Please, Cara, is that...is that true?!

If it pleases you, Cara, I would like to go to
Dagsion at once.
I never knew there was anything that handy! Have you ever used one, Olympia?

Cara...I don't understand. Why would you go to
so much effort on my behalf?

Oh, wow... Does that mean that Cara
herself is the mother of Leda's...ancestor?

Cara, I heard you wanted to see me. What can
I do for you?

Cara, goddess of mine heart, your favorite
mischievous breeze has just blown in.
So, are you saying someone's pulling the strings behind the people on the Mardle List?

Cara herself said she wants to get to the truth
behind the Cydonia Massacre, did she not?
...Leda and Olympia really are close, aren't they?
Oh, Buccaneer, you don't have to cry.

Yes, I think it does. I also think it's time to take
everything we've uncovered to Cara.

Ahh... What a magnificent fight. Wouldn't you
agree, Otto?
Hello, Cara. I understand you wanted to see me?

Cara told us right before the start of the games
that you wanted to participate.
Normally, we couldn't allow an exception like this, but since Cara herself requested it...

Best of luck with your match! I'll be rooting for you.
I hope you'll excuse me now, Cara.
Sirocco, were you planning to hit on that person too?

If anything happened to me, it would upset Cara.
And all you care about is getting in her good graces.

Family is important. I'd like to see House Cohendia
restored as well...for the sake of Quijermo.

Of course, Cara. I'm happy to do anything I can
for you.

I'm...sorry. That's not something I can do. Not even
for you, Cara.
I'm here, Cara. And I'm so sorry I kept you waiting.
How unusual. Cara, I thought you didn't much care for watching fights.
Thank you, Cara.

Stop! This is a foolish line of thought, and Cara
would never want this for you.
If that happens, there's a risk that even Cara won't be able to protect you.

But Sirocco, are you going to tell Cara about
this plan?
What have you done?! Quijermo...

Miss Leda, you said before that you were a guest of
Mardle's.

I did some research on him and found something
odd. Mardle did not have a family.
Why would Mardle lie to you about that?
Miss Leda, if I recall, Mardle served for many years as high priest at the temple of Sorell.

Exactly. I'd like to see what kind of information
I can gather about Mardle.

It seems Mardle had reason to, at
the very least, resent Quijermo.

I never knew about any of what happened between
